label: Synthetic Saathi playbooks for the demo knowledge index. Not legal or regulatory advice.

playbooks.title: Hospital bill with an insurance funding gap
steps: Collect the itemized final bill and the health policy schedule.
Check eligible inpatient expenses, room category limits, and claim document requirements.
Calculate verified coverage and what the family can pay now before considering credit.
Borrow only the remaining gap, and only if the EMI passes the affordability guardrail.
Submit the claim with the full document set and track partner status until closure.

playbooks.title: Unrecognized UPI debit
steps: Confirm the debit is unfamiliar and note the transaction reference, time, and counterparty.
Block or pause UPI in the payment app and change the UPI PIN.
Report the incident to the bank or payment app as soon as possible; prompt reporting can limit customer liability under bank rules.
Report cyber fraud on the national helpline 1930 or at cybercrime.gov.in.
Track the dispute reference until the payment network closes it.

playbooks.title: EMI shortfall this month
steps: Confirm the EMI amount, due date, and the expected shortfall.
Check whether essential spending can be deferred without penalties.
Ask the lender about restructuring or a revised due date before taking new credit.
Route to a specialist when income loss or distress is reported.
